text:
A careful week at the desk began with your clear note, and we are sincerely sorry for the missed connection and the trouble it caused for you and your companion animal. You explained that the transfer broke down, baggage and pet handling became messy, and the plan you relied on fell apart under pressure.

We are taking this seriously. Aurelia Skyways expects prompt, respectful communication, and this case should have been handled with more care from the start. The Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed the file, and we are moving it through the normal review path so the next step is clear and steady. <<FACT F110>> We are also making sure the claim record is complete so there is no extra back and forth. <<FACT F116>> Please keep any receipts, boarding notes, and any written updates you have already received, since those details help us close the loop without delay.

We know travel with a pet is not something anyone should have to defend after a disruption. Phoebe, if she was the pet involved, should have been kept safe and calm throughout the trip, and that expectation matters here. If anything in the handling felt uncertain, we want that flagged now so it can be reviewed with care. We appreciate your patience while the case is checked, and we will continue to respond in a calm, stepwise way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
